title_en: Come Back to Me, Dear Love
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Sounds like a modern pop-style song; origin unclear, no author I can name. The second stanza's meaning is slightly contradictory in the original; I translated it literally.

lines.cyr: Врати ми се, мило либе, при мене,
lines.lat: Vrati mi se, milo libe, pri mene,
lines.en: Come back to me, dear love, to my side,

lines.cyr: душата ме боли, либе, за тебе,
lines.lat: dušata me boli, libe, za tebe,
lines.en: my soul aches, love, for you,

lines.cyr: уште еднаш да те, либе, прегрнам
lines.lat: ušte ednaš da te, libe, pregrnam
lines.en: to embrace you, love, one more time

lines.cyr: и љубовта, мило либе, да ти ја вратам.
lines.lat: i ljubovta, milo libe, da ti ja vratam.
lines.en: and give you back, dear love, your love.

lines.cyr: Не ме чекај веќе, либе, да ти дојдам,
lines.lat: Ne me čekaj veḱe, libe, da ti dojdam,
lines.en: Do not wait for me any more, love, for me to come to you,

lines.cyr: и љубовта, мило либе, да ти ја вратам,
lines.lat: i ljubovta, milo libe, da ti ja vratam,
lines.en: and give you back, dear love, your love,

lines.cyr: јас не можам, мило либе, да преболам,
lines.lat: jas ne možam, milo libe, da prebolam,
lines.en: I cannot, dear love, get over it,

lines.cyr: при моите очи друга да љубиш.
lines.lat: pri moite oči druga da ljubiš.
lines.en: that before my eyes you love another.

lines.cyr: Отров ми зададе, либе, на душава,
lines.lat: Otrov mi zadade, libe, na dušava,
lines.en: You gave poison, love, to this soul of mine,

lines.cyr: и сè се угасна, либе, во мене,
lines.lat: i sè se ugasna, libe, vo mene,
lines.en: and everything went out, love, inside me,

lines.cyr: се угасна мојта љубов за тебе,
lines.lat: se ugasna mojta ljubov za tebe,
lines.en: my love for you went out,

lines.cyr: кога знам да друга љубиш при мене.
lines.lat: koga znam da druga ljubiš pri mene.
lines.en: when I know that you love another beside me.
